#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Since static pod has no podstatus saved except in mirror pod, so while init container GC'd  and kubelet restarts, static pod can only generate its pod status from current runtime, but after https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/96572 merged, init containers would not be re-created again, so we should reset init-container status for static pod correctly.

issue_context.title: Static pod status is always Init:0/1 when init container GC'd before kubelet restart.
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

When init container of static pod was GC'd and kubelet was restarted. The status of the static pod is alway Init:0/1 and never come back to Running.


```shell

kube-controller-manager-paas-192-168-16-112     0/1     Init:0/1                0          11d     192.168.16.112   paas-192-168-16-112   <none>           <none>
kube-controller-manager-paas-192-168-16-113     1/1     Running                 1          11d     192.168.16.113   paas-192-168-16-113   <none>           <none>

```

### What did you expect to happen?

The pod status is Running

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

1. remove exited init contianer of one static pod.
2. restart kubelet

### Anything else we need to know?

I noticed #96572 makes containers not restarting after init container GC'd. Non-static pod has no problem, but static seems to be affected by it.

### Kubernetes version

<details>

v1.22.1

</details>


### Cloud provider

<details>
Local Cluster
</details>

comments:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/88886#issuecomment-800764877
> I noticed #96572 makes containers not restarting after init container GC'd. Non-static pod has no problem, but static seems to be affected by it.

kubelet will check the status of the main containers before restarting the init container. If init is not finished like `Init:0/1` and the main container is not started yet, the init container should be recreated. My question is how to make a static pod hung in `init: 0/1` status. Does the init container fail to start or exit with a non-zero status?

> [#88886 (comment)](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/88886#issuecomment-800764877)
> 
> > I noticed #96572 makes containers not restarting after init container GC'd. Non-static pod has no problem, but static seems to be affected by it.
> 
> kubelet will check the status of the main containers before restarting the init container. If init is not finished like `Init:0/1` and the main container is not started yet, the init container should be recreated. My question is how to make a static pod hung in `init: 0/1` status. Does the init container fail to start or exit with a non-zero status?

Do you mean this issue? this issue is that while kubelet restarts, static pod object has no podstatus saved, so its new podstatus is generated by runtime, but the init container is lost and would not be created again, so its state becomes Waiting, so is the case described by this issue.
